required_before_reissue: Capture a complete sanitized current schema for all nine unledgered Production relations, including columns/defaults, constraints, indexes, triggers, policies, grants and relevant function bodies.
Prove ownership and version/hash status of each unledgered object; retain the zero-row candidate migration ledger fact and do not invent migration receipts.
Rehearse the effective 17-file sequence against a disposable PostgreSQL 17 database initialized with the complete captured schema and synthetic-only data; record per-file receipts and catalog deltas.
Validate actual Production grants and C2 function/trigger fingerprints against the fail-closed C2 preflight without applying the migration.
Verify old-runtime compatibility for private dashboard-image reads and the shift identity index transition.
Obtain a secured offsite backup and independently restored copy; the current Supabase organization is Free and automatic backup/PITR evidence is unavailable.
Verify Drive OAuth runtime principal and effective parent ACL; keep storage routes inactive until then.
Obtain Owner approval for the exact effective migration hashes, operation order, stop conditions and recovery procedure.
stop_conditions: Any effective migration hash mismatch or version already recorded in the target ledger.
Any unledgered pre-existing relation whose exact definition or ownership is not verified.
Lock timeout, nonzero migration exit, or incomplete per-migration receipt/catalog delta.
Unexpected active storage route or unverified Drive principal/ACL.
No verified independent backup/restore or old-runtime compatibility.
recovery_plan: No Production migration is authorized by this plan; executable_allowlist remains empty.
Secure an external encrypted backup and independently restore it into isolated PostgreSQL 17 before any Production mutation.
Apply only the separately Owner-approved effective sequence after unledgered objects pass exact preflight; do not bulk db push or alter the ledger to imply work.
On any error, stop and preserve exact state/logs; do not blindly retry or drop objects. Use only a reviewed forward repair or the verified restore procedure.
Keep the old application only if old/new read/write compatibility has passed; otherwise a database restore is the only proposed recovery and is not currently proven for Production.
